summary: Targeted frontend bug-fix verification passed on the public preview. Project images 001-003 loaded from the expected uploaded PNG paths with complete=true, naturalWidth>0, visible rendered dimensions, computed opacity 0.95, and filter:none. Project 004 removed its failed image and displayed the numbered radial-gradient placeholder. The lightened 25% overlay, preloader timing, desktop nav, and console/page error regressions also passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend intentionally skipped. Public asset checks returned image/png for wealth-builder.png (170026 bytes), schedule-planner.png (171154 bytes), and faithflow.png (829965 bytes). Browser checks: project 001 natural size 1895x1067, project 002 1911x1067, and project 003 1899x747; each was complete, rendered at non-zero size, display:block, visibility:visible, opacity:0.95, and filter:none. Project 004 had zero img descendants after onError and showed visible radial-gradient placeholder text 004. Overlay computed as rgba(5,5,5,0.25) to transparent. Preloader detached in 3105ms; About and Work nav landed at 90px. No console errors, page errors, or visible error messages. ESLint passed.
rca_of_the_issue: The uploaded files were valid and served correctly, but the former grayscale/low-opacity/heavy-overlay treatment visually obscured them. The updated image class now renders at 0.95 opacity with no filter, and the overlay is only 25% dark at its strongest point, so the screenshots are clearly visible. The intentionally missing fourth asset triggers onError state and swaps the img out for the existing placeholder without exposing a broken-image icon.
